name: New England Detective: Breakfast in Boston
source:
Ingmar Gustafson, an alcoholic nihilist that spends all his time at an Irish pub in Newton, doesn’t paint the typical picture of a successful man. But don’t let looks deceive you; this unassuming Swede happens to be the best private detective in all of Boston.

When the beautiful heiress to the massive Svardfisk Corporation goes missing under mysterious circumstances, it falls on this dauntless detective to don his trench coat once more and go in search for her. 

A tale of treachery, beauty and passion, don’t miss the first installment in the New England Detective series. NED: Breakfast in Boston is a crime mystery detective visual novel with an intriguing dating sim aspect.

[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/1090470/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
英格玛·古斯塔夫森 (Ingmar Gustafson) 是一位酗酒的虚无主义者，他一生都在牛顿的一家爱尔兰酒吧里度过，他并没有描绘出成功男人的典型形象。但不要让外表欺骗了你；这位谦逊的瑞典人恰好是整个波士顿最好的私家侦探。

当庞大的斯瓦德菲斯克公司的美丽女继承人在神秘的情况下失踪时，这位无畏的侦探再次穿上风衣去寻找她。

这是一个关于背叛、美丽和激情的故事，不要错过新英格兰侦探系列的第一部分。NED：《波士顿的早餐》是一部犯罪悬疑侦探视觉小说，其中包含有趣的约会模拟内容。

[来自[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/1090470/]Steam[/url]]
